_meta.description: Static TMDB → egydead embed URLs map. Manually maintained for v1 pilot. Each entry lists per-host embed URLs; the extractor picks the right port from hostExtractors/ based on the host name.
_meta.note: Later iterations will replace this with a live fetch: POST tv9.egydead.live/{slug}/ body='View=1' → parse <ul class='serversList'>. Kept static now so we can integration-test the host extractors on real content without also debugging the egydead scraper.
